content.text: I’ll trace the existing comment schemas, repository patterns, and issue read permissions, then add the three requested exports following the project’s conventions.

input.command: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/lib/permissions.ts && sed -n '1,200p' src/server/services/_support.ts && rg -n \"TenantScope|tenant.scope|NotFound|PermissionDenied|permission-denied|assertOrgScope|assertCan\\(actor, \\\"comment:read\\\"|Issue .*not found|requireFound\" src"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/schemas/member.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/server/db/schema/members.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/server/db/schema/issues.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/server/db/schema/comments.ts && rg -n \"findMember\\(\" src"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,200p' src/schemas/common.ts && rg -n \"listMembers\\(|nextCursor\" src/server/services | head -50 && rg -n \"export interface Issue|type Issue\" src/types/issue.ts && sed -n '1,120p' src/types/issue.ts && sed -n '1,90p' src/server/services/member-service.ts"
